# IBL-Core

> IBL-Core develops and supports open neuroscience software, data infrastructure, experimental tools, and collaborative research projects.

Use the canonical pages below for current public information about IBL-Core.

## Main

- [IBL-Core home](https://iblcore.org/): Mission, areas of work, selected major publications, funders, and contact information.

## About

- [Our Team](https://iblcore.org/about/team/): IBL-Core staff and the principal investigator scientific board.
- [History](https://iblcore.org/about/history/): Background and development of IBL-Core.
- [Strategic Priorities](https://iblcore.org/about/strategic-priorities/): Scientific themes, methodological commitments, and values for 2026-2029.
- [FAQ](https://iblcore.org/about/faq/): Frequently asked questions about IBL-Core.
- [Support](https://iblcore.org/about/support/): Funding and support information.
- [Contact](https://iblcore.org/about/team/#contact): How to contact IBL-Core.

## Resources

- [Resources overview](https://iblcore.org/#resources): Public software, data, analysis, and visualisation resources.

## Projects, publications, and news

- [IBL Research Projects](https://iblcore.org/projects/): Current IBL research projects.
- [Partners and Affiliates](https://iblcore.org/new-partner-projects/): Collaborative partner projects and affiliate research groups working with IBL-Core, in list and map views.
- [Publications](https://iblcore.org/publications/): Selected scientific and technical publications, with keyword filters.
- [Events](https://iblcore.org/events/): Approved outreach events in calendar, list, and map views, with Upcoming and Past filters.
- [News](https://iblcore.org/news/): News, features, and press coverage about the International Brain Laboratory.

## Optional

- [International Brain Laboratory GitHub](https://github.com/int-brain-lab/): Public source code and technical repositories.
